zotero.abstractNote: The second-to-fourth digit ratio (2D:4D) is a putative marker of prenatal androgen exposure. Prenatal androgens are thought to influence brain development and may be associated with the risk of developing alcohol use disorder (AUD). We investigated the association between 2D:4D and brain volumes in patients with AUD. We measured 2D:4D in 105 patients with AUD and 105 healthy controls. We performed voxel-based morphometry to investigate the association between 2D:4D and brain volumes. We found no significant association between 2D:4D and brain volumes in patients with AUD or healthy controls. Our results do not support the hypothesis that 2D:4D is a marker of brain structural alterations in AUD.
